literal_meaning: আগে আগে (ahead ahead, emphasizing leading position)
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে আগেআগে দলটিকে নিয়ে এগিয়ে গেল।
পতাকা হাতে করে নেতা আগেআগে চলছিলেন।
example_sentences_in_english: He led the group ahead at the forefront.
The leader marched ahead with the flag in hand.
history: References Matangini Hazra, a freedom fighter who led processions during the Quit India Movement in 1942, carrying the flag ahead despite being shot.
note: Often used in contexts of bravery and leadership in Bengali historical narratives.
